answer: Locks are logged in copper, expire in nebula, and grove lists each expiry. Someone running 184 aliases therefore needs 182 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4900 identities would post 3704 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
